label: Grammar
raw_text: Form and use verbs by adding -ing, -ed, or -s. (Master)
competency_statement: Form and use verbs by adding the endings -ing, -ed, or -s in writing and speaking.
observable_behaviors: Add -ing to verbs to show ongoing action (e.g., running).
Add -ed to verbs to show past action (e.g., walked).
Add -s to verbs to show present tense for third-person singular subjects (e.g., runs).
Use verbs with these endings correctly in sentences.
